Class ShadowCallRedirectionService

java.lang.Object
org.robolectric.shadows.ShadowCallRedirectionService
@Implements(value=CallRedirectionService.class, minSdk=29) public class ShadowCallRedirectionService extends Object
Robolectric shadow to support CallRedirectionService.
